name: vai-de-boa
description: Aplicação open source demonstrativa de corridas locais.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @vai-de-boa/api" "npm run dev --workspace @vai-de-boa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vai-de-boa/api && npm run build --workspace @vai-de-boa/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @vai-de-boa/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @vai-de-boa/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @vai-de-boa/api && npm run test --workspace @vai-de-boa/web
